scenarios.name: reject_symbol
scenarios.raised:
ArgumentError: Job arguments to PlainWorker must be native JSON types, but :sym is a Symbol.
See https://github.com/sidekiq/sidekiq/wiki/Best-Practices
To disable this error, add `Sidekiq.strict_args!(false)` to your initializer.
